note: zzip_mem_entry_new() (zzip/memdisk.c) fetches header via zzip_disk_entry_to_file_header(disk, entry) (zzip/mmapped.c) -- which returns 0 for a crafted disk_entry file-offset that lands outside [disk->buffer, disk->endbuf) -- and immediately uses it, with no null check in between, to compute item->zz_data and to read the file header's extras length/pointer (both header-relative pointer arithmetic). A failed lookup is dereferenced anyway, so a crafted disk_entry that fails the offset check still causes the caller to walk into a heap-based out-of-bounds read through the unguarded header pointer.

traces.message: zzip_disk_entry_to_file_header(disk, entry) : can return 0 for a crafted disk_entry file-offset; the lookup validates only the offset range, not the candidate header's magic-number field
struct zzip_file_header *header = zzip_disk_entry_to_file_header(disk, entry) : return value stored with no null check
item->zz_data = zzip_file_header_to_data(header) : header dereferenced unconditionally -- heap-based out-of-bounds read once a failed lookup is walked
